This is a Full Time Job

The Role

We're looking for a talented Social Media Editor / Creator to join our marketing team and help bring our stories to life across social platforms. In this role, you'll create engaging short-form video content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and X, helping translate longer-form content into social-first edits that connect with audiences.

You'll work closely with the Marketing, PR and Creative teams to deliver high-quality video assets that support campaigns, events, and studio storytelling.

This is an exciting opportunity for an editor with strong technical skills and a passion for film, storytelling and social media to develop their craft while working with world-class creative content.

Key Responsibilities
• Edit short-form social video content across multiple platforms.
• Repurpose longer-form content into engaging social edits.
• Optimise videos for platform formats and audience engagement.
• Collaborate with the Marketing and PR teams to deliver campaign assets.
• Manage multiple edits and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Apply brand guidelines to ensure consistency across social content.
• Support versioning and delivery of video assets for social channels.
• Track and respond to feedback from internal stakeholders.

We're looking for someone passionate about social storytelling and comfortable working in a collaborative creative environment.
• 3–5 years of experience editing video content.
• Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.
• Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or similar platforms.
• Good understanding of social video pacing and audience engagement.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail and organisation.

Desirable
• Basic motion graphics skills in After Effects.
• Experience repurposing long-form content into social edits.
• Interest in film, visual effects or entertainment marketing.
• Familiarity with social media performance metrics.

What We're Looking For
• A creative editor with strong instincts for social video.
• Someone comfortable executing briefs and collaborating with marketing teams.
• A proactive team player who enjoys working in a fast-moving environment.
• An editor excited by the opportunity to work with premium film and creative content.

Additional Information
Framestore brings together world-class producers, artists, and technologists to craft visually striking work across advertising, episodic, and immersive productions. Our teams blend creative ingenuity with cutting-edge technology to deliver high-end visual effects, immersive storytelling, and premium content for global clients, brands, and broadcasters. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we combine talent and technology to bring life to everything we create, setting out every day to reframe the possible.
